decisions.reason: Swam in amber captures 출렁이고; dim dawn captures 어스름한 새벽. BASE’s glowed and in the darkness lose the sway and add darkness.
Preserves 고요 속에서 and the middle-voice clench of 주먹이 불끈 쥐어진다. BASE drops the silence and makes the clench fully volitional.
시도 is attempts; 굳은 공력 is solidified, not condensed.
SOL drops 톡톡히 (well/amply) from the Skill Points doing their job.
가능성이 보인다 is seeing a possibility, not a way through that bleeds into the next fortress-gate image.
SOL restores 작고 허술해지고; break through overstates 문을 열. BASE’s cracking and crumbling is the wrong image.
decisions.replacement: The impregnable fortress was starting to look smaller and flimsier. If I kept pounding away at it, I felt like I would soon be able to open the gate.

decisions.reason: The sit-down beat belongs in the merged next sentence; keeping BASE here would duplicate it.
Merge is sound, but SOL’s cross my legs weakens 가부좌 and circulation drops 운기조식’s qi.
decisions.replacement: I was just about to sit cross-legged and begin circulating my qi again when my senses, sharpened by the many earlier rounds of circulating my qi, picked up an unusual sound.

decisions.reason: 흘려보냈다 is let energy flow, not channeled.
항산검문이다 is its own beat; splitting it from the battle line matches the Korean pause.
Companion split: 드디어 전투가 벌어진 것이다 stands alone after the sect identification in H010.
일어섰다 is stood; rose is a looser synonym with no gain.
차례차례 is one after another, not merely one by one.
결국…… has no So; SOL adds a commentary tone.
Countless deaths is cleaner parallel English for 죽음을 지켜봤다 after countless battles, without changing the sense.
터지고 is blown apart; blown to pieces overspecifies the burst.
SOL adds simply and of the world, and drops 자리 잡은 (established).
단순히 is simply, not easily.
Glinted is the better verb for torchlight 비친다 on dried blood.
하나도 빠짐없이 죽어 있었다 is every one of them dead, not spared.
SOL’s split and trembling are better, but rose weakens 울려 퍼졌다; restore rang out.
decisions.replacement: One of the martial artists holding a torch in a trembling hand doubled over. Soon, the sound of retching rang out from all around us.

decisions.reason: Keep 분명 and the 침이 마르게 idiom; drop SOL’s unsupported greatest.
decisions.replacement: “Somi. That was definitely her name. The day I became acting Family Head, the Branch Leader of Eung-hyeon bragged about her until his mouth ran dry, calling her his treasure.”

decisions.reason: Light about to go out is the natural English for 꺼질 듯한 눈동자; BASE’s ready to go out is calqued.
SOL adds from the darkness, which this sentence does not state.
어떤 최후 is what kind of end, not merely what end.
Intentions as the subject making him sick is punchier and still matches 구역질이 났다.
미친 사이코패스 새끼들 is one insult; BASE splits it, SOL drops 미친.
이처럼 될 것이다 is you will end up the same way, not the same thing will happen to you.
SOL adds a man; 얼굴도 모르는 needs no extra gender noun.
The Korean trails off at 이리 참혹하게……; SOL completes it into were killed.
바라보는 is looking over the corpses, not a gaze that passed over them.
Something was missing from this NPC is more natural English for 어딘가 결여되어 있다.
Split clauses read cleaner while keeping shut mouth and twisted expression.
사람들의 눈만 없었다면 is if no one had been watching, not had we been alone; 기세였다 is looked ready.
SOL captures 하대; at first is unsupported—Korean is they did not register it.
decisions.replacement: He had abruptly dropped into the speech of a superior addressing an inferior, yet the shift was so natural that neither Jin Wikyung nor I even registered it.

decisions.reason: Keeps 곳 and 전날; SOL’s never overstates 전혀 for this instance.
달려야 is run/rush, not ride; 하고자 했다면 is wanted to save, not tried; 그렇지 않으냐 is isn’t that right.
하얗게 질린 is stronger than pale; blood ran is more idiomatic for 선혈이 흘렀다.
희생이 따르는 is comes with sacrifice, not demands sacrifice.
SOL drops 가득했다; the emptiness fills the face.
안 그렇소 is isn’t that so; is that not so is stiffer without a register gain.
Drops unsupported respectful; 포권을 취해 보이는 is giving the salute.
Tighter list syntax; at the sight of those children’s corpses matches 시체를 보고도 without adding while looking.
내 시선에서 is from my perspective, not hedging; 인간미도 넘치고 머리도 영특하다 is humane and sharp-minded, not merely compassionate and intelligent.
크게 흔들렸다 is shaken more deeply, which BASE underplays.
도움을 줬다 omits the object; English needs him, and the help is clearly to Wikyung.
Keep the 건가 question; 뭉친다 is closed ranks, not BASE’s bland united. SOL’s Maybe turns it into a statement.
decisions.replacement: *Were they enemies in peacetime but closed ranks during war?*

decisions.reason: 다행인데 is that’s a relief; If so tracks 그럼 after the speculation.
바라보던 is looking at, not watching.
노회한 잿빛 눈동자에 is at those eyes; SOL adds an unsupported turn toward him.
One sentence: he looks at Taekyung who is hiding surprise. SOL splits and loses simultaneity.
큰 공을 세울 is about to distinguish himself / earn great merit, not generic accomplish great things.
걸출한 마두 is an exceptional demon, not a formidable villain; 전력이지 is is, and 아닐 테고 is isn’t, not cannot be.
앞장서서 싸우는 is the idiom lead from the front.
물끄러미 바라보던 … 물었다 is gazing at the smile, then asked; SOL replaces that with stared and turned.
외통수 is the one word that comes to mind; Checkmate, not a paraphrase I was cornered.
Title 임무 수행 is Carry Out Missions; body needs 임무를 수행 and 공적을 쌓다 (build), plus 휘하에 (under you).

>
> **Quest**

decisions.reason: 잠시 자리를 비웠던 is briefly stepped away; BASE is vague and SOL’s earlier drops 잠시.
decisions.replacement: I closed the Quest Window. I had already seen it several times, and besides, the White Tiger Hall martial artist who had briefly stepped away had just returned.

decisions.reason: 조잡하게 modifies 수놓아진, so crudely embroidered, not a crude tiger.
The known pavilion was the assigned quarters; SOL’s a pavilion had been assigned changes the identification.
Keep 우선 (first); 인적이 없는 is deserted, not merely empty.
decisions.replacement: After leaving White Tiger Hall, I first ducked into a deserted alley.

decisions.reason: Restores 마술을 보여 줄 수 없는, which BASE drops.
Glossary 태원진가; 평범한 무사1 is Ordinary Martial Artist #1, not Generic Jin Family Martial Artist.
The omitted subject of 타협을 봤지 is the two negotiators; Taekyung was the object of the deal, not we.
Restores 어렵지 않은 정찰조장 as the undemanding recon-leader post under White Tiger Hall’s Leader.
어어, 하는 사이에 is before he could get a word in, not before I knew it.
배 째라 is do whatever the hell they wanted, not dug in heels and refused; 언급할 때마다 does not name the Head Elder as speaker.
Two-beat 그래픽이고 / 허상일 뿐이야 lands cleaner as separate clauses.
이대로라면 is at this rate; BASE drops the conditional.
몰입하지 말자 as don’t get sucked in is natural gamer self-talk without changing the warning.
정말 사람이라고 생각하고 is actually thinking, not starting to; SOL’s actual relationships is extra.
It startled me every time is more direct for 깜짝깜짝 놀라곤 한다.
Split arrival and 입을 벌렸다 so the shock lands as its own beat.
가족 같은 기업 is the sarcastic family-company joke; treats its employees like family is the standard English landing.
엿 좀 먹어 보라 is eat shit; screwing me over changes the insult.
Wailed is the direct verb for 울부짖는; the foot is the step he just took.
